hook: WILL WE MAKE IT? Will we make it in life?
transcript: Will we make it in life? Yes. How are you so sure? Because we'll keep trying. And if we don't make it? There's no way we don't. And if we end up in the streets? Then I'll build us the cutest tent on the street. My Shakespeare man.
